contexts.text: That a peg, or nail, = affixion or adjunction. Illustrated.

All the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass () = all the things which conjoin together and strengthen both Heavens, the Middle and the Ultimate, through good; (for) pins = things which conjoin together and strengthen. AC 9777:2, Illustrated.
Unless poisonous serpents were held tight with pegs...
